description: Where is it cheapest to send this transaction right now?. Ranks all 6 supported chains (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Solana) by USD cost for a transaction type (transfer, USDC transfer or swap) at a speed tier (slow/standard/fast). Returns the ranking, the cheapest chain, and any chains queried in parallel that didn't respond (in failed[]). Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402).
name: compare_gas_costs
